newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 96 prelim GDP growth 6.9 pct yr/yr - govt.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 96 prelim GDP growth 6.9 pct yr/yr - govt.

text.p: Slovakia's real GDP growth for the full year 1996 was 6.9 percent, compared with 7.4 percent GDP growth in 1995, the government said on Tuesday.
"Slovakia's economy continued to grow in 1996 and preliminary figures show real GDP growth of 6.9 percent," a statement issued at a regular government meeting said.

The statement added that the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) expected the GDP to grow by 5.7 percent in the first half of 1997, year-on-year, while average annual inflation was seen at 6.0 percent by the end of the first half of the year.
Last year's GDP totalled 581.3 billion crowns, the statement added.
